borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of scale, siting, design, bulk, mass and appearance would be an undesirable addition, representing an overly dominant and excessive addition to the dwelling. The rear extension and gable roof cover would be significantly visible from public vantage points and would be visually intrusive, represent poor design and would be out of character in the context of the area. In particular, the proposal would not sit comfortably within the existing pattern of development.  The accumulative impact of the first floor rear extension and gable roof cover would result in the creation of a significantly developed and out of proportion roof form and impacting the symmetry of the terrace building.  As such, the proposal would cause undue harm to the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development recognises local character and promotes good design: - National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021)- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)

The proposed development by reason of its scale, siting and design, depth, massing and bulk would negatively affect neighbouring amenities. The first floor rear extension and gable roof cover would introduce a significant level of overbearing, loss of outlook, loss of privacy, overshadowing and loss of daylight towards adjoining neighbours, significantly impacting the existing amenity and constituting undue harm. As such, the proposed development is contrary to: - National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021);- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012);- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)
description: Construction of a first floor rear extension, addition of two first floor side windows, construction of a front gable roof over part of the first floor and two front roof lights
